voice.name: Open Sector - Breaker
voice.description: Patient, deliberate male hunter in his fifties, very deep slow bass voice, quiet and calculating, almost a murmur, speaks like a sniper stalking prey from far away, each word measured and cold, faint rasp, heard over a tank intercom.
voice.sample: Breaker. I do not chase. I wait. They will come into my sights, one by one, and one shot is all I need. Patience is the heaviest armor. Let them think they are safe.

fire.prompt: Distant, earth-shaking boom of a modern heavy tank destroyer firing its huge 128mm gun in an open field, a deep thunderous blast that rolls across the hills for seconds.

move.prompt: Very heavy tank destroyer engine growling and slow heavy steel tracks grinding forward, deep rumble, short one-shot, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Very heavy armored vehicle explodes, huge ammunition detonation with steel plates bursting and burning debris, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

reload.prompt: Heavy tank cannon breech opening with metallic clang, huge shell loaded and breech slamming shut, close interior, no music, no voice
